title: Welcome
note: The envelope, the name, one line of what the book is. One button: begin. (v1.0 has no "I was invited": no invite can exist without a server, so the door is hidden until co-parent sharing ships.)
text: Early Letters The baby memory book you fill by talking. A few words at a time, in your own voice. Kept for your child to read and hear for years. Begin the book
